resources.string: "Import a PBW. Matching Gabbro, Emery and Flint runtimes are included. Other platforms require an optional runtime import. Stock firmware has no Health Connect bridge. Configuration and watch buttons are on the main screen. Internet is optional. Compatibility remains experimental."

"Optional: share steps and the latest fresh heart-rate reading from Health Connect with the virtual Pebble. No data is written back. A compatible health-enabled emulator firmware is required. Reading does not create measurements; another source must supply them. Watchfaces with permitted internet access may transmit values. You can skip this page and change access later."
"Health Connect is unavailable (Android 14 or later required)."
"This firmware has no Health Connect bridge"
"Included: Gabbro, Emery and Flint. A matching platform is selected automatically."
"This WebView cannot enable emulator memory. Update Android System WebView; the installed provider must support cross-origin isolation."

"Engines for all seven platforms are included. Import firmware for Aplite, Basalt, Chalk or Diorite. Gabbro is preferred, then Chalk."
